description: Describe one resource in an ArcSync diagram: its type, IaC attributes, and every relationship in and out (what it calls, reads, is attached to, or is contained by). `resource` may be the resource id, its name, or a substring; an ambiguous match returns the candidates to choose from.

graphId.description: The diagram's graphId, as list_diagrams or get_diagram returns it. The id start_parse returned also works.

resource.description: Resource id, name, or a substring of either.

name: describe_resource
title: Describe a resource
